mutations.name: fallback-never-substituted
mutations._mechanism: Row 2776 restored: a fallback interpreter without pytest is used as-is, so every write to a target with no project venv is DENYed pytest-missing.

mutations.name: project-venv-substituted
mutations._mechanism: A project venv without pytest is silently replaced by a PATH python, so the judge measures under an interpreter that is not the project's and the misconfiguration is never reported.

mutations.name: substitution-unreported
mutations._mechanism: The judge measures under a different interpreter than it was given and never says so; a DENY then cannot be traced to the interpreter that produced it.

mutations.name: untrusted-substitute
mutations._mechanism: Any python3.N on PATH may measure RED for a production write, so a PATH entry a worker can influence chooses the interpreter whose result decides ALLOW.
